body.statement: For fixed \(C\in\mathcal D_G\) and \(D\in\mathcal D_H\), every observable mixture law generated from \(C\) by arbitrary independent nonconstant non-Gaussian real sources, without centering or moment restrictions, is generated from \(D\) if and only if there exist a surjection \(f:U_C\twoheadrightarrow U_D\) and nonzero scalars \(a_i\) with \(C_{:,i}=a_iD_{:,f(i)}\) for all \(i\in U_C\).  Necessity is certified by one admissible Bernoulli diagnostic in its original free jump lattice, and sufficiency merges sources along the fibers of \(f\) while preserving nonconstancy and non-Gaussianity.
body.proof_tex:
For a fixed mixing matrix \(A\), let \(\mathscr L(A)\) have the meaning in Lemma \(\texttt{lem:finite-mixture-containment-unrestricted}\).  With \(A=C\), the assertion that every observable mixture law generated from \(C\) is generated from \(D\) is exactly \(\mathscr L(C)\subseteq\mathscr L(D)\).  That lemma proves
\[
 \mathscr L(C)\subseteq\mathscr L(D)
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 \exists f:U_C\twoheadrightarrow U_D\;
 \exists(a_i)_{i\in U_C}\in(\mathbb R\setminus\{0\})^{U_C};
 \forall i\in U_C:\ C_{:,i}=a_iD_{:,f(i)}.
\]
Its necessity invokes the explicitly constructed Bernoulli diagnostic of Lemma \(\texttt{lem:diagnostic-mixture-rigidity}\), whose jump generators are free in their original lattice.  Its sufficiency uses the fiber sums in equation (10), with nonconstancy proved by support and non-Gaussianity by Lemma \(\texttt{lem:levy-cramer-decomposition}\).  Zero columns contribute nothing and receive arbitrary legal independent sources.  This proves both directions, including invisible columns, irreversible source merging, and source-law symmetries, without a centering or moment assumption.
body.justification: A single admissible Bernoulli diagnostic eliminates the unrestricted source-law quantifier and the constructive converse merges sources while preserving the population source class.
body.gap: Dai et al. treat observational zero-allowed distributional equivalence, but the present theorem exposes the exact visible-column surjection, invisible columns, and irreversible merging needed inside the common-mechanism intervention criterion.
body.consumer: The population compilers enumerate finite source-partition types instead of optimizing over arbitrary probability laws.
